verses.text: First of all, I urge that requests, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be made for everyone,
including kings and all those in authority, so we can live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
This is good and pleasing to God our Savior,
who wants everyone to be saved and to come to know the truth fully.
There is one God and one mediator between God and humanity: Christ Jesus, himself human,
who gave himself as a ransom for everyone. This was the testimony given at the right time.
For this I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
So I want men everywhere to pray, lifting holy hands without anger or argument.
In the same way, women should dress modestly and with good judgment, not with elaborate hairstyles, gold, pearls, or expensive clothes,
but with good deeds, as is fitting for women who claim to honor God.
A woman should learn quietly and with full submission.
I don't permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she should remain quiet.
Adam was formed first, then Eve.
Adam wasn't deceived, but the woman was deceived and became a transgressor.
But women will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with good judgment.
